threat_event: Ransomware operator signs in through the controls contractor's remote-desktop tool with a stolen or reused password and encrypts the BAS front-end workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote-desktop tool; one shared contractor account; password only; no session approval or log; workstation without patches or antivirus since March 2025
existing_controls: Field controllers keep running last programs; Building Engineer can run rooftop units by hand
treatment_plan: Replace the contractor tool with the MSP remote access service: named accounts, MFA, per-session approval by the Building Engineer, session recording; EDR on the workstation with the contractor's approval

threat_event: After ransomware or a disk failure the BAS front-end workstation and controller programs cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workstation image never restore-tested; 30-day, non-immutable backup behind one MSP password; field controller programs held only by the controls contractor; no rebuild checklist
existing_controls: Nightly image of the workstation (unproven)
treatment_plan: Immutable 90-day backup with MFA on the console; controller program copies after every change; restore test by 2026-10-15 then quarterly; rebuild checklist with the controls contractor

threat_event: Ransomware that starts with a phishing email on an office computer spreads over the flat Property A network to the BAS workstation, cameras, and the synced shared drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internal network for office computers and building devices; antivirus alerts in business hours only; no phishing training; desktops sync the shared drive
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and patching on office computers; firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic
treatment_plan: Building-device network segment at each property with deny-by-default rules; MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting; annual training with quarterly phishing simulations

threat_event: Guarantor and applicant files are taken during ransomware or a mailbox takeover, requiring Florida breach notice to about 60 people
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Social Security numbers, driver license copies, and credit reports kept indefinitely in the shared drive and email; synced to desktops
existing_controls: MFA on email; laptops encrypted
treatment_plan: Move guarantor files into one restricted folder excluded from desktop sync; purge files past retention; stop emailing applications

threat_event: Attacker takes over a platform administrator account and unlocks doors, changes schedules, or issues credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on any administrator account; security integrator's standing full administrator account is shared by its technicians; nobody reviews administrator changes
existing_controls: Vendor lockout on the portal; door events logged
treatment_plan: MFA on every administrator account; remove the integrator's standing account and grant time-limited access on request; monthly administrator change review

threat_event: A former tenant employee or contractor enters after hours with a credential that was never disabled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credentials disabled only when a tenant asks; no periodic review; 51 of 342 credentials unused for 90 days or more
existing_controls: Door events logged; entrances locked after hours
treatment_plan: Quarterly credential confirmation by each tenant contact; automatic disable after 90 days unused; departure notice clause in the lease renewal template

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent change of a contractor's bank details and a misdirected payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes accepted by email; no call-back rule; no phishing training
existing_controls: MFA on email and the property management system
treatment_plan: Call-back rule using a known number for any bank detail change; training (R-003)

threat_event: Anyone with access to the engineering room or the network changes setpoints or programs on the BAS workstation, and nobody can tell who did it
threat_source: Insider; contractor technician; intruder on the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared 'engineer' login with automatic sign-in; password written on the workstation; no change log
existing_controls: Engineering room needs a credential
treatment_plan: Named workstation accounts for the Building Engineer and each technician; automatic sign-in off; screen lock; password manager

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability on the BAS workstation, which has not been patched since March 2025
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Excluded from MSP patching and antivirus at the contractor's request with no written exception; BAS software one major version behind
existing_controls: Firewall blocks inbound traffic
treatment_plan: Monthly patching of the workstation with the contractor's tested approval and a written exception process; BAS software upgrade at the next service visit

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management platform reaches every office computer and the backup console
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP has administrator reach into every office computer and the backups; no evidence of how the MSP protects its own platform; no incident notice clause
existing_controls: MSP contract with named technicians
treatment_plan: Yearly MSP security review with evidence (MFA on its platform, technician list); 24-hour incident notice and a recovery time in the contract at renewal

threat_event: A breach at the controls contractor or security integrator gives attackers a working path into the building systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared contractor accounts; no security terms or incident notice clauses in either agreement
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Security addendum for both: named accounts, MFA, 24-hour incident notice, copies of controller programs, end of standing access

threat_event: An incident is handled late or badly: building systems stay down longer, and Florida's 30-day notice or the 72-hour lease notices are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan or contact list before 2026-08-31; no manual operating procedures; staff had no reporting route
existing_controls: Cyber insurance with a breach hotline
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook (done 2026-08-31); printed binder; tabletop with the MSP and controls contractor by 2026-11-30

threat_event: Card numbers written down from phone orders are stolen or misused, and the company loses SAQ P2PE eligibility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff write card numbers on a notepad before keying them; notes go in the office trash
existing_controls: P2PE terminal keeps card data out of company systems
treatment_plan: Key phone orders directly into the terminal while on the call; never write card data; destroy the notepad; brief staff

threat_event: The P2PE terminal is tampered with or swapped to capture card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No terminal inspections or tampering training (PIM controls)
existing_controls: Terminal kept behind the management office counter
treatment_plan: Weekly inspection checklist from the PIM; serial number record; tampering briefing for the 3 staff who use it

threat_event: Guarantor files and credit reports are kept for years and thrown away unshredded, exposing personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention or disposal rule; printouts go in the recycling bin
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Retention schedule in POL-04; locked shred bin; purge the backlog; disposal record

threat_event: The face match trial creates face templates of tenant employees without notice, and a wrong mismatch alert leads to a person being challenged
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature turned on in June 2026 at the integrator's request; no assessment, notice, or approval; vendor terms allow use of customer video to improve models
existing_controls: Feature paused on 2026-07-24
treatment_plan: P10 assessment and decision; vendor deletion of templates and training opt-out in writing; approval rule for analytics features (POL-04 4.6)

threat_event: The Building Engineer is unavailable during an incident or hurricane, and nobody else can run the BAS or the plant by hand
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual procedures exist only in the Building Engineer's head; technicians not trained
existing_controls: Controls contractor can visit the next business day
treatment_plan: Written manual operating procedures for each rooftop unit and the doors; train one Maintenance Technician; sealed copy of credentials in the binder

threat_event: A hurricane closes one or both properties and damages rooftop units, doors, or network equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida coastal metro; rooftop equipment; one internet line per property
existing_controls: Property insurance; contractors on call
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan (shut down and protect equipment, export credential list, photograph equipment); pre-season contractor call list

threat_event: An internet outage at Property A stops platform administration, camera recording, and BAS remote alarms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One business internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Door controllers cache credentials; BAS runs locally
treatment_plan: Accepted: phone hotspot for administration during outages; revisit if outages exceed one business day a year

threat_event: The access control cloud platform is down longer than the 72-hour credential cache
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dependence on one cloud vendor
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability controls; 99.9% target; doors fail secure with free egress
treatment_plan: Accepted: track the vendor's status page; on-call guard if an outage passes 24 hours

threat_event: Attacker activity on the building network or in the platform goes unnoticed for weeks because no logs are reviewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No log review; firewall logs kept 7 days; remote-desktop sessions not logged
existing_controls: Platform keeps administrator logs 1 year
treatment_plan: Monthly log review checklist; MSP log service with 1-year retention for firewall and remote access logs

threat_event: Someone on the Property A network signs in to the supervisory controller with the manufacturer's default password and changes setpoints or schedules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supervisory controller web interface accepted the manufacturer default administrator password (P07 test 2026-08-11); flat network
existing_controls: Field controllers keep last programs; Building Engineer can run units by hand
treatment_plan: Controls contractor changes the default password to a unique passphrase in the password manager; check every new device at commissioning

threat_event: A lost tablet or a stolen unencrypted desktop exposes cached files or saved passwords
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Desktops not encrypted; tablets self-managed with user-set passcodes; a 2025 tablet loss was never reported
existing_controls: Laptops encrypted; office locked after hours
treatment_plan: Full-disk encryption on the desktops; tablets enrolled in the MSP's device management with a passcode rule and remote wipe

threat_event: An attacker reaches the Property B door controllers and cameras through the ISP router's default administrator password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Property B router on ISP default settings with the factory administrator password and UPnP on (P07 test 2026-08-11); building devices share it with tenant kiosk Wi-Fi
existing_controls: Platform-managed devices with vendor firmware
treatment_plan: Replace with an MSP-managed business router; separate network for building devices; change default credentials
